mentions.name: Eremoterra
mentions.description: An MCP server that acts as a persistent lore record and provides orientation tools for an open world text adventure game played through AI agents. The setting is an empty Earth—all natural landscape with no human constructions until players start playing and occupying it. Built with Rust and RocksDB.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An MCP server to act as lore persistent record and tools to orient an open world text adventure game played through AI agents.

The theme is an empty Earth. All natural Earth with no human constructions (until the players start playing and occupying it).
mentions.author: pontes
